name: 01 / GOOD WORK PAYS
title: Small tasks. Useful work. NIM rewards.
subtitle: Bountex · Nimiq Mini Apps · Earn
narration: Bountex turns small, useful tasks into NIM rewards. Good work pays.

name: 02 / FIND A BOUNTY
title: Find something worth doing.
subtitle: Reward · time · requirements
narration: Find work in design, development, writing, research and community. Each bounty shows its reward, estimated time and deadline.

name: 03 / POST USEFUL WORK
title: Clear tasks make good work possible.
subtitle: One task · one worker · an offered NIM reward
narration: Creators define the task, requirements and NIM reward. Rewards are offered, not escrowed. Creators pay directly after approving the work.

name: 04 / CLAIM THE TASK
title: Know the mission before you start.
subtitle: Instructions · acceptance requirements · progress
narration: Workers read the mission and acceptance requirements, then claim a task. Their workspace keeps the work and its progress visible.

name: 05 / SUBMIT YOUR PROOF
title: Show what you completed.
subtitle: Notes · proof links · private evidence uploads
narration: Submit notes, a proof link or private attachments. Drafts are preserved, and the creator can review the evidence.

name: 06 / REVIEW THE WORK
title: A clear review keeps work moving.
subtitle: Approve · request revision · reject with a reason
narration: Creators approve submissions, request a revision with a reason, or reject the work. Approval and payment have distinct statuses.

name: 07 / PAYMENT STATUS
title: A sample receipt, clearly labeled.
subtitle: Preview receipt · no NIM transferred
narration: This is a preview receipt. No NIM was sent. Live payouts stay pending until the backend matches the transaction and verifies a macro checkpoint.

name: 08 / TRY BOUNTEX
title: Do useful work. Earn NIM.
subtitle: bountex.vercel.app · github.com/greyw0rks/bountex
narration: Bountex is open-source, and the hosted demo uses mainnet. Native sign-in and a real reward transfer are the next acceptance checks.
